notes: MvPolynomial.coeff was removed, so the statements write f.coeff m (and (... ).coeff m) for coeff m f; p.coeff m elaborates to the term the old MvPolynomial.coeff m p unfolded to, so the propositions are unchanged. In proofs, MvPolynomial.coeff_add and coeff_zero are now protected and named, the zero coefficient is simplified with Finsupp.coe_zero and Pi.zero_apply, Finsupp.finset_sum_apply is now finsetSum_apply, simp unfolds AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff in place of the removed coeff, and the tensor-product inductions drop their zero case.
